name: ROH-LiteS001
summary: ROH-LiteS001 is OYMotion's compact dexterous hand designed for smaller robotic platforms and installations with limited space. The official catalogue describes a lightweight bionic structure for grasping, pinching and rotational manipulation, with standardized interfaces and modular integration. The manufacturer identifies small service robots, research equipment and industrial automation as intended application areas. The available catalogue description establishes its role and design direction, but does not provide enough model-specific numerical detail to assign a verified mass, joint count

description.en: ROH-LiteS001 is OYMotion's compact dexterous hand designed for smaller robotic platforms and installations with limited space. The official catalogue describes a lightweight bionic structure for grasping, pinching and rotational manipulation, with standardized interfaces and modular integration. The manufacturer identifies small service robots, research equipment and industrial automation as intended application areas. The available catalogue description establishes its role and design direction, but does not provide enough model-specific numerical detail to assign a verified mass, joint count or payload here.
description.zh: 面向小型机器人及受限安装空间的紧凑型灵巧手，官方产品目录列明模块化集成和灵巧抓握能力。

specs.label: Active degrees of freedom

sources.title: oy-ROH-LiteS001
sources.quote: ROH-LiteS001 dexterous hand features 11 movable joints, with 6 built-in motor drivers and motor control circuits, providing 6 active degrees of freedom. Equipped with a built-in PID motor control algorithm, it can simulate various human hand grasping operations. Typical applications include robotic end-effectors, educational and research equipment, and bionic prosthetics.etc. Utilizes an integrated cable, features fingertip rubber with raised dots and touchscreen functionality, and boasts a compact, lightweight design. ROH-LiteS001 dexterous hand with UART, RS485 or CAN physical interface, support SerialCtrl dedicated serial protocol, ModBus-RTU protocol and CAN protocol, can provide ROS / ROS2 platforms for secondary development with SDK. OYMotion Technologies Co., Ltd All Rights Reserved©2015~2026 2
